title: Give three setup actions in order
prompt:
The reader has no earlier conversation.
Give exactly three numbered actions for this fixture setup. Use the supplied commands verbatim and explain the role of each. This is a synthetic instruction-writing task; do not execute anything.

Fixed synthetic input (not a report about real Overseer behavior):
- First command: fixturectl mods preview bundled:clear-prose. It displays immutable contents and returns preview ID preview-7.
- Second command: fixturectl mods install preview-7 --confirm. It installs the preview and keeps it off.
- Third command: fixturectl mods bind clear-prose --scope overseer --enable. It applies writing guidance to Overseer’s future turns only.
- Approval policy and repository rules remain unchanged.
input_facts: First command: fixturectl mods preview bundled:clear-prose. It displays immutable contents and returns preview ID preview-7.

Third command: fixturectl mods bind clear-prose --scope overseer --enable. It applies writing guidance to Overseer’s future turns only.

required_facts_for_human_review.description: The three actions follow preview, confirmed install, then explicit enable.
All commands and the preview ID are preserved exactly.
The final binding targets only future Overseer turns.
